meta.name: HK Store — Accessible Streetwear Editorial DNA
meta.description: Three-dimensional Design DNA profile for HK Store: high-contrast urban streetwear editorial e-commerce system engineered for WCAG AA accessibility, fast product discovery, tactile spring micro-interactions, and lightweight frosted-glass & dual-image visual effects.
source_references: Contemporary Streetwear Editorial E-Commerce Systems (Represent, Fear of God Essentials, Musinsa Standard)

primary.role: Primary brand ink, dominant CTA buttons, active states, editorial headlines, and tabular prices

secondary.role: Hover states on dark actions, deep charcoal editorial sections (Lookbook & Footer), and protective image scrims

accent.role: Streetwear vermilion accent for sale/discount badges, low-stock urgency cues, and active wishlist hearts

neutral.usage: Warm alabaster (#F6F5F0) page canvas reduces eye strain while pure crisp white (#FFFFFF) elevates product cards, drawers, and inputs; #575752 muted charcoal guarantees >= 6.8:1 WCAG AA contrast for secondary copy.

typography.font_style_notes: Unified geometric sans-serif system ('Montserrat' weights 400–900 with full Vietnamese diacritics) across all display headlines, UI body copy, SKU labels, and tabular numerals (tnum) on prices and counters.

spacing.section_rhythm: Alternating spacious 72px editorial sections on warm alabaster canvas punctuated by full-bleed obsidian dark bands (Hero, Lookbook, Footer) and crisp 24px product grid gutters.

layout.grid_system: CSS Grid 12-column conceptual layout with dedicated 4-column storefront showcase grids, 280px sticky catalog filter rail + 3-column fluid product grid, and 55/45 split product detail gallery.

shape.divider_style: Crisp 1px solid #DEDCD3 structural hairlines paired with 2px solid #111111 editorial section anchors.

iconography.preferred_set: Lucide / Custom authored inline SVG (zero emoji substitutes)

motion.easing: Animate UI physics springs via CSS linear() paired with exponential ease-out cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)
motion.entrance_pattern: Viewport-staggered 16px upward spring entrance with 4px surface blur clearing to crisp rest state, respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
motion.exit_pattern: Fast 160ms–200ms in-place scale/opacity dismissal on cubic-bezier(0.33, 0.17, 0.67, 0.5) with immediate inert focus handoff.

components.button_style: High-contrast solid #111111 primary buttons and crisp 1px #111111 outlined secondary buttons, 4px radius, uppercase 0.05em tracking, tactile 0.97 press scale.
components.input_style: 44px accessible touch-target height, #FFFFFF background, 1px #DEDCD3 border transitioning to #111111 with soft 3px halo focus ring and WCAG-compliant placeholder contrast.
components.card_style: 3:4 fashion portrait ratio, dual-image hover crossfade, top-left semantic badges, top-right floating wishlist heart button, slide-up Quick View action bar, color swatch dots, in-stock size preview, and tabular counter price.
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky frosted-glass header with gliding highlight bar, instant live-search autocomplete dropdown, wishlist drawer trigger, and slide-over mini-cart drawer.
components.modal_style: 3D perspective spring-dialog entrance over blurred dark scrim with keyboard focus trap, used for Quick View, Smart Fit Finder, and Policy sheets.
components.list_style: Structured editorial rows with thumbnail, clear hierarchy, live stock indicators, and accessible quantity steppers.
components.component_notes: All interactive Fashion E-Commerce enhancements are modularized behind HK_FEATURE_FLAGS so individual features can be toggled on/off cleanly.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Curated streetwear flagship showroom & lookbook magazine

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous warm-alabaster breathing room around 3:4 portrait garment photography so silhouettes and fabric textures command attention.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Anchored top sticky navigation and strong full-bleed dark editorial bands balanced by airy light-mode product grids.
visual_language.contrast_level: High contrast (#111111 ink on #F6F5F0 / #FFFFFF surfaces, >= 7:1 primary & >= 4.5:1 secondary)
visual_language.texture_usage: Subtle radial editorial lighting in dark sections and frosted translucent glass overlays on sticky bars and quick-view controls.

composition.flow_direction: Z-pattern hero entry transitioning into rhythmic 4-column/3-column scannable vertical catalog rows.
composition.grouping_strategy: Tight internal card clusters (swatch + title + size availability + price) separated by 24px gutters and 2px section header rules.
composition.negative_space_role: Separates dense size/color variant metadata so first-time shoppers never feel overwhelmed.

imagery.photo_treatment: 3:4 portrait studio and street-style photography on neutral concrete/warm gray backdrops with protective bottom gradient scrims whenever overlaid with white typography.
imagery.illustration_style: Minimal geometric monoline SVG icons; zero cartoon illustrations.
imagery.graphic_elements: Color swatch circles with crisp inner hairlines, discount percentage pills, and progress bars for free-shipping thresholds.
imagery.pattern_usage: Restrained subtle architectural grid/vignette lighting on hero & lookbook banners.
imagery.image_shape: Crisp 4px softly rounded rectangles maintaining strict 3:4 garment aspect ratios.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate physical press scale (0.97 buttons, 0.985 cards), spring badge pops, and non-intrusive stacked toast confirmations.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Fine-pointer gated: secondary angle photo crossfade, Quick View bar reveal, subtle -3px card lift, and gliding nav highlight.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Smooth opacity + 2px blur image swap and requestAnimationFrame tabular price roll-up.
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Focused on high-value shopping moments: heart toggle pop, mini-cart free-shipping meter glide, live search preview, and instant size recommendation.

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Direct, helpful, style-savvy Vietnamese streetwear consultant
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Clear explanation paired with an immediate recovery action button (e.g., 'Khám phá sản phẩm', 'Xóa bộ lọc').
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Calm, specific about stock or input constraints, and constructive.

background_effects.description: Subtle dark radial spotlight and protective multi-stop editorial vignette over Hero and Lookbook backgrounds to guarantee headline legibility.

particle_systems.description: Disabled intentionally to preserve clean editorial focus on garment photography and maintain 60fps mobile battery efficiency.

3d_elements.description: Heavy WebGL 3D disabled; 3D spatial depth is achieved lightweightly via CSS perspective(500px) rotateX modal entrances.

shader_effects.description: Custom GLSL shaders disabled to keep zero-dependency file:// compatibility and instant load times.

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: IntersectionObserver threshold 0.08 with -30px bottom rootMargin plus rAF top scroll-progress bar
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: One-shot viewport batch stagger (65ms step, 260ms cap) for cards/sections; continuous rAF scaleX(0..1) for reading progress bar

scroll_morphing.description: Sticky navbar transitions into compact elevated frosted-glass surface when window.scrollY > 24px, accompanied by a floating Back-to-Top pill after 420px.

text_effects.description: Display headlines remain immediately visible for LCP; prices animate with requestAnimationFrame tabular number roll-up (NumberCounter).

cursor_effects.description: Spring-driven gliding highlight pill behind desktop navigation links following pointer and keyboard focus.

params.size: matches hovered nav item bounding box

image_effects.description: Dual-image angle crossfade + subtle 1.04x zoom on product card hover, paired with 2px blur crossfade when switching detail gallery thumbnails.
image_effects.technology: CSS opacity & transform transitions gated by @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)

canvas_drawings.description: Disabled; all progress meters and dividers use crisp GPU-composited CSS transforms.

svg_animations.description: Tactile spring pop animation on SVG Wishlist heart icon fill/stroke toggle and Cart/Wishlist counter badges.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Effects are strictly budgeted to CSS compositor properties (transform, opacity) and targeted backdrop-filter on sticky/overlay chrome. On devices with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or hardwareConcurrency <= 2, scroll-linked motion and image zoom gracefully degrade to instant accessible state changes while preserving full visual contrast.
